thread:
Sam (CS): Quick week0 smoke for Crestline private/VPC onboarding. Summary: VPCs and peering look good, IAM roles validated, two blockers: KMS rotation script failed on alias mismatch and audit records arriving with flattened userIdentity (no sessionContext). Tagging @Ivy and @Diego. :wave:

Ivy (Platform): Can you paste a sanitized log snippet and the exact error? I'll try repro on the staging mirror.

Sam (CS): Log sample (redacted):
- eventTime: 2026-06-11T07:45:12Z
- eventName: RunTask
- userIdentity: type=AssumedRole arn=arn:aws:sts::888888888888:assumed-role/CrestlineDeploy/Runner  // sessionContext missing

Rotation error: "Error: KMS alias \"alias/crest-prod-enc\" not found" (actual alias in acct is alias/crest-prod-enc-2026-06).

Diego (Security): Two likely paths: CloudTrail configured without management events or the log-forwarder (Fluentd/Splunk) flattens nested fields. I'll check CloudTrail includeManagementEvents and the delivery role trust.

Ivy (Platform): I'll push a small rotation-script patch to accept date-suffixed aliases (regex fallback) and add a validation step. Patch ETA: EOD today. Also applied a temporary egress rule for their collector SNI; will revert after verification.

Sam (CS): Plan: Ivy patch + Diego audit. If unresolved by Fri 18:00 PT we'll mark a medium renewal risk and book a remediation call with the customer next week. 20m sync tomorrow 11:00 PT.

HealthBot: smoke-check 1799999991 | network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail | artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/crestline/week0/1799999991

Sam (CS): Thanks team 44d I'll DM Crestline ops a short summary and request read-only log access if needed.
